recognize_zh: 疏鬆水腫的組織中散在大型異型細胞，核大、空泡狀染色質、核仁明顯，混雜小淋巴球與溢出的紅血球；但本視野無法清楚看出這些大細胞侷限於血管腔內，需以 CD34 等血管標記確認。
features: Scattered large atypical cells with enlarged vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli
Irregular nuclear contours with moderate amphophilic cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes and extravasated red cells
Loose, edematous stroma with thin-walled capillary channels
Intravascular location of the large cells not clearly demonstrated at this magnification
describe_en: Tissue section shows loose, edematous stroma containing a mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei, irregular nuclear contours and prominent nucleoli. Thin-walled capillary channels and extravasated red cells are present. The large cells appear to lie in and around small vascular spaces, but a strictly intravascular distribution cannot be confirmed on this H&E field alone. The findings are compatible with involvement by intravascular large B-cell lymphoma in the appropriate context; CD20 with CD34 or CD31 immunostaining is recommended to demonstrate intraluminal localization.

ddx.vs: Conventional DLBCL forms extravascular sheets or masses, whereas IVLBCL cells are confined to vessel lumina on CD34/CD31 staining.
Reactive immunoblasts are admixed with plasma cells and a polymorphous background and are polytypic without clonal B-cell restriction.

ddx.dx: Metastatic carcinoma or melanoma in vessels
ddx.vs: Tumor emboli are cohesive and keratin+ or S100/SOX10+, rather than discohesive CD20+ CD45+ lymphoid cells.
Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+ CD15+ with weak PAX5 and are set within a rich inflammatory background forming nodules, not intravascular.
